first_page: Shopping: /shop/ (product lookup by name or barcode from the open product databases with a camera scanner, the same search on 12 stores, a list and cart with tax and shipping by store, CSV and a share link, parcel tracking by carrier format and check digit, a price log with targets, unit prices, wish lists, return windows) and one page per lane site: /shop/track/, /shop/wishlist/, /shop/barcode/, /shop/list/, /shop/product/, /shop/parcels/. Verse does not stock or ship goods and says so. Will not build: a catalogue of its own, payments, reviews, scraped prices or scraped carrier status, affiliate links (money rule).

uses.about: What Verse uses from each site as well as matching it (owner: "use the sites as well as beat them"): the links a person follows, never a scrape.
uses.amazon.com: the search address https://www.amazon.com/s?k=... (and amazon.co.uk, amazon.de) opened from the list, the product lookup and the wish list; track.amazon.com for TBA numbers
uses.packagetrackr.com: nothing: the carriers' own pages are linked instead
uses.upcitemdb.com: nothing yet: its API needs a key and has a daily cap (a candidate, below)
uses.parcelsapp.com: nothing: the carriers' own pages are linked instead
uses.openfoodfacts.org: the product API (v2 product by code, cgi/search.pl by name) from the visitor's browser; ODbL database, Database Contents License rows, CC BY-SA images, credited on every page; rate limits 15 product reads and 10 searches a minute per address

candidates.what: affiliate links (Amazon Associates, eBay Partner Network)
candidates.why_not_now: touches money: STANDING.md's money rule; links carry no tag today

candidates.what: UPCitemdb trial API for codes the open databases lack
candidates.why_not_now: a key and a daily cap; terms not read from this network

candidates.what: carrier status by official carrier APIs (UPS, USPS, FedEx, DHL developer APIs)
candidates.why_not_now: each needs an account and a key held as a secret, and a server route; terms not read

candidates.what: a camera scanner for browsers without BarcodeDetector (a vendored decoder such as ZXing, Apache-2.0)
candidates.why_not_now: size; the typed box covers it today
